purpose: Build an allowlisted high-quality Python reference pool for an equal-token reference arm. This pool is not the raw candidate corpus and must not tune Stage B.
selection_rule: Use fixed public repositories with permissive licenses and broad Python ecosystem recognition. Resolve each default branch to a commit before file content fetch, then sample eligible Python source files by a stable hash of repository, commit, path, and seed.

repositories.quality_basis: Widely used Python web framework with mature review and maintenance practices.
Widely used Python CLI framework with compact, mature source code.
Canonical Python HTTP library with stable public maintenance history.
Core Python testing framework with extensive public maintenance and review.
Widely used Python data validation library with modern typing-heavy code.
Widely used Python packaging tool with production-grade application code.
Mature scientific Python library with strong review norms and stable APIs.
Large, actively maintained Python ML library with broad ecosystem usage.

forbidden_uses: using this pool as the raw candidate corpus
using target-model Utility, benchmark outcomes, or human/LLM review labels to choose files
changing Stage-B objective weights based on this pool
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Known-high-quality reference-pool construction only; no target-model training or Utility claim.
